title: HTTP API
key_points: The Arweave HTTP API allows interaction with the Arweave network using standard HTTP requests.
It supports key functionality such as querying block information and submitting transactions.
Documentation is provided for each available endpoint, including required parameters and responses.
limitations: Lacks detailed explanations or context around the purpose of the different endpoints.
Assumes prior knowledge of Arweave concepts and terminology.
Some examples may require additional setup or credentials to run successfully.
asserts: The provided documentation thoroughly covers how to use each endpoint in the Arweave HTTP API for interacting with the Arweave network.
scope: Describes and documents all available endpoints, parameters, and responses in the official Arweave HTTP API.
